content.title: San Antonio Spurs vs LA Clippers Live Stream: How to Watch NBA
content.text: Victor Wembanyama and the San Antonio Spurs continue to close in on the top seed in the Western Conference. On Monday night, they take on a Los Angeles Clippers team trying to help its positioning in the Play-In Tournament. On Monday night, Victor Wembanyama is back on the floor and leads the red hot San Antonio Spurs (49-18) into Los Angeles to take on the LA Clippers (34-33). The Spurs have won six of their last seven games and 17 of their last 19 going back to the start of February. They’ve been quickly climbing the standings and are now well within range of the Oklahoma City Thunder – who they would join as just the second 50-win team in the NBA this season with a victory on Monday. How to Watch San Antonio Spurs vs Los Angeles Clippers Today: Game Date: Monday, March 16, 2026 Game Time: 10:00 p.m. ET TV Channel: FanDuel Sports Network SoCal, MyNetworkTV (KGBT – Harlingen/Weslaco/Brownsville/McAllen, TX) Location: Intuit Dome Live Stream the San Antonio Spurs vs Los Angeles Clippers game: Start watching now! Wembanyama has, of course, been a major part of that. Last time out against the Charlotte Hornets on Saturday he scored a team-high 32 points on 13-of-24 shooting and added 12 rebounds and eight assists. For the season he’s now averaging 24.3 points and 11.2 rebounds per game, as well as three blocks. On the other side on Monday is a Clippers team that had won four games in a row and seven of eight going back to the start of March, but lost last time out, falling 118-109 to the Sacramento Kings on Saturday. Still with the recent surge the Clippers have jumped up to the eighth spot in the Western Conference, putting them in position to play in the Play In Tournament after a terrible beginning of the season.
